I am extremely disappointed with the level of care my family received from Dr. Kumari. My mother had an appointment due to severe stomach pain that had lasted for three days. She could barely walk, felt nauseous, and had intense cramping radiating to her back. During the appointment, Dr. Kumari only pressed on her stomach (which caused my mum to scream in pain) and then prescribed omeprazole — without carrying out any basic tests such as blood or urine checks.

Shockingly, my mother was told she would have to wait six weeks for a scan. Later that same day, her condition worsened, and she had to be taken to hospital. She was diagnosed with acute cholecystitis, treated with IV antibiotics, and is now awaiting laparoscopic cholecystectomy. A simple urine test at the GP surgery would have shown signs of infection and helped avoid a potentially dangerous delay in treatment. The lack of proper examination and follow-up was incredibly irresponsible.

In a separate case, the same doctor prescribed cream for my young nephew’s face, assuming he had psoriasis or dry skin. However, the issue turned out to be skin tags around his eyes, which clearly needed a different type of assessment and care.

These experiences have left me deeply concerned about the quality of care and the lack of thoroughness shown during appointments. A more careful and investigative approach should be expected from any GP, especially when patients present with such serious symptoms.",null,[0,113]]]],[null,1757078259000000,1757078259000000,"6 months ago",null,"https://business.google.com/local/business/2044778934332335789/customers/reviews/reply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMnBqZDFVeVNYbFVNSFF6VmxaS1VVNVZaSFpTU0VaTVpXMXJOVlZ0WXhBQhAA",[null,null,null,"/local/business/2044778934332335789/customers/reviews/reply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMnBqZDFVeVNYbFVNSFF6VmxaS1VVNVZaSFpTU0VaTVpXMXJOVlZ0WXhBQhAA"],"https://business.google.com/local/business/2044778934332335789/customers/reviews/deletereply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMnBqZDFVeVNYbFVNSFF6VmxaS1VVNVZaSFpTU0VaTVpXMXJOVlZ0WXhBQhAA",[null,null,null,"/local/business/2044778934332335789/customers/reviews/deletereply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMnBqZDFVeVNYbFVNSFF6VmxaS1VVNVZaSFpTU0VaTVpXMXJOVlZ0WXhBQhAA"],null,"https://business.google.com/local/business/2044778934332335789/customers/reviews/reply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMnBqZDFVeVNYbFVNSFF6VmxaS1VVNVZaSFpTU0VaTVpXMXJOVlZ0WXhBQhAA",[null,null,null,"/local/business/2044778934332335789/customers/reviews/reply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMnBqZDFVeVNYbFVNSFF6VmxaS1VVNVZaSFpTU0VaTVpXMXJOVlZ0WXhBQhAA"],null,["en"],[["Dear Ludmila,
